t: By default, a $(l:router/modular_router)router/$ ticks every 20 server ticks, or once per second. On each tick, every installed module is executed in order, left to right.$(p)If you need a router to run faster than this, add $(thing)Speed Upgrades/$; each Speed Upgrade reduces the tick interval by 2 server ticks, down to a minimum of every 2 server ticks (or 10 times per second).
默认情况下，$(l:router/modular_router)路由器/$每20个服务端刻运行一次，即每秒运行一次。每次运行周期中，所有已安装模块将按从左至右顺序依次执行。$(p)若需路由器运行得更快，可添加$(thing)速度升级/$；每个速度升级可将运行周期缩短2个服务端刻，最低可降至每2个服务端刻运行一次（即每秒10次）。

The base tick rate, tick increase per upgrade, and hard minimum tick rate are all configurable in the module's config (config/modularrouters-common.toml).$(p)For performance reasons, $(l:upgrades/stack)Stack Upgrades/$ should be preferred over Speed Upgrades where possible; use Speed Upgrades judiciously and only where absolutely required for maximum item transfer rate.$(p)Be Kind To Your Server (tm).
基础运行周期、每次升级带来的周期缩减量，以及硬性最低运行周期，均可在模块配置文件（config/modularrouters-common.toml）中调整。$(p)出于性能考量，$(l:upgrades/stack)堆叠升级/$应优先于速度升级使用；请审慎使用速度升级，仅在绝对需要最大化物品传输速率时才启用。$(p)善待你的服务器（tm）。
